jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Extensibility Platform
jobs.description_text: About our organization The Developer Experience & Product Platform (DEeP) organization empowers all of Stripe's products with a shared product platform that delivers high-quality, consistent, cross-product experiences across our UI and API surfaces. DEeP focuses on providing a scalable developer experience that any developer can leverage to accelerate a customer's ability to create value from Stripe. Within DEeP, the Extensibility program is how Stripe expands its total addressable market, and increases customer retention. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable — customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform. Stripe has three interconnected extensibility primitives: Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration). Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences. Workflows — A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations. These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch. jobs.title: Company Nurse
jobs.description_text: This role requires a unique combination of clinical nursing expertise and occupational safety specialization. The candidate must be a licensed nurse with Safety Officer certification and BOSH training, proficient in first aid, BLS, CPR, workplace health assessments, and HMO coordination. In addition, a candidate must be knowlegable of DOLE OSH standards, hazard assessment (HIRAC), incident investigation, emergency drill facilitation, and compliance documentation, skills that go beyond general nursing practice. Equally critical is their ability to design and implement employee wellness programs and mental health initiatives aligned with Republic Act 11036, as well as developing health education campaigns. This blend of regulatory compliance, risk management, and wellness program design is a rare, specialized competency not typically found among existing employees.

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher - Entry Level 2027
jobs.description_text: Belvedere Trading is a leading proprietary trading firm proudly headquartered in downtown Chicago. Our traders work hard to provide liquidity to the market through their market-making activities and are the masters of a diverse set of commodities, interest rates, exchange-traded funds (ETF), and equity index options. From the beginning, we began iteratively investing in our proprietary technology and committing to building our systems from the ground up. Our trading models and software systems are continually re-engineered, optimized, and maintained to stay on top of the industry. This wouldn’t be possible without the dedicated efforts of our technology teams who utilize and perfect our innovative technology solutions. High-performance proprietary trading and development is the source of our success and competitive advantage at Belvedere, further fueling our passion for performance. We are a team driven by intellectual curiosity, seeking answers that will change not only how we trade in this technological age, but also the future landscape of the trading industry. Additionally, certain positions at Belvedere Trading are eligible for discretionary bonuses. Our employees have access to a variety of benefits, which can be found on our website here.

jobs.title: Trading System Support Analyst
jobs.description_text: Our Intel team focuses on delivering high-quality technology solutions to our core and affiliated groups. We go all-out to understand and support end-user needs, leverage data to gauge effectiveness, and advance our trading infrastructure by developing cutting edge and mission-critical support for our trading platform and applications. We look for passionate team members that excel and their contribution is critical to our continued success. We are seeking a Trading System Support Analyst (TSSA) to join our team. This position offers an opportunity to learn Belvedere’s proprietary technology and trading operations in a challenging, fast-paced setting. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with strong technical knowledge and exceptional communication skills. You will need proficiency in troubleshooting and information gathering to help peers and developers resolve complex issues. Our teams provide around-the-clock support to facilitate fast issue resolution for our traders.

jobs.title: Account Director, Enterprise Nordics - 11957
jobs.description_text: The Impact of an Account Director, Enterprise Nordics at Coupa: As an Enterprise Account Director at Coupa, you will drive our growth by prospecting, qualifying, pursuing, and closing opportunities within strategic accounts with revenues over USD 1bn. Your focus will be on targeting new logo prospects and building strong relationships with key decision-makers such as CPOs, CFOs, CIOs, and other customer stakeholders and influencers. By developing trusted advisor-level relationships, you will position Coupa as the preferred partner and create new business opportunities in collaboration with our digital transformation partners. Your contributions as an Enterprise Account Director will directly impact our success in expanding our market presence and driving revenue growth. Through your strategic approach and deep understanding of our customers' needs, you will establish Coupa as the go-to solution for their business challenges. Your ability to foster trusted relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders will drive new business opportunities and solidify Coupa's position as the Total Spend Platform leader. Join us in shaping the future of enterprise accounts and play an instrumental role in driving the growth and success of Coupa on a global scale. OTE range SEK 1 975 000-2 237 667 with a mix of 50/50 The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

jobs.title: AI Engineer - 11927
jobs.description_text: The Impact of a AI Engineer at Coupa: We are seeking a hands-on Agentic AI Developer / AI Engineer to design, build, test and deploy agentic AI solutions leveraging Google Cloud's AI ecosystem. This role is a core part of our AI Delivery "Build" team, responsible for translating business challenges into production-ready AI agents and solutions using Google ADK (Agent Developer Kit), Vertex AI, and related Google Cloud services that create measurable business value. This position combines deep technical expertise with practical execution on Google's AI platform, ensuring that our agentic AI solutions are well-designed, robustly built, and successfully deployed. The Agentic AI Developer will partner closely with business stakeholders, QA Specialists, and Cloud Engineers to build, test, and scale responsible AI solutions from concept to production within the Google Cloud environment. In a forward deployed role, You will embed directly with the portfolio teams whose problems you are solving, work in their tools and their meetings, and deliver agentic and automation solutions in the flow of work: inside the systems people already use every day, not as one more application they have to learn.

jobs.title: AI-Native Functional Consultants Lead
jobs.description_text: Rossum Solution Delivery is standing up AI-Native Services Delivery as a formal operating model inside Coupa Value Services. We are hiring the leader of its functional-consulting layer — a Senior Manager seat reporting to the RVP Solution Delivery, leading a team of seven senior functional consultants who deliver the Rossum-functional side of enterprise customer implementations. The operating model you would join Already shipping, not slideware. Our delivery team runs with agents in the loop — over ninety tools and eighteen production skills in an internal agentic toolchain, built by delivery practitioners for delivery practitioners, on top of Rossum’s own AI engine. We build our own AI. We did not build a business by prompting someone else’s. If that distinction matters to you, this seat will feel like the right place.

jobs.title: Associate Security Engineer - 11925
jobs.description_text: The Impact of an Associate Security Engineer at Coupa: Coupa's Security Engineers keep our enterprise, product, platform, and customer data safe. As an Associate Security Engineer, you'll build your foundation in cloud, application, and infrastructure security by contributing to real, well-scoped engineering work alongside experienced teammates. You'll partner with Engineering, IT, and Compliance, learn how we build durable, automated security tooling instead of one-off fixes, and grow your root-cause analysis skills with mentorship and regular feedback. This is a role for someone early in their security career who wants hands-on ownership of growing scope — with the support to get there.

jobs.title: Associate Security Operations Analyst - 11953
jobs.description_text: The Impact of an Associate Security Operations Analyst at Coupa: Coupa Software is looking for an Associate Security Operations Analyst to assist with the maintenance and development of the global corporate security program. This position will report to the VP, Security & Compliance and will primarily focus on Incident Response within a zero-trust environment utilizing a cloud first approach to accommodate a remote workforce and scripting knowledge (Python, JavaScript, Bash / Shell). This position will require a good understanding of both security and infrastructure frameworks as duties can range from threat hunting/log analysis to system administration or basic software development functions. If you are a motivated self-starter with a passion for learning and bias for action, this position is for you.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer - 11950
jobs.description_text: About the Role We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Core Product Engineering organization within the Integration/ MAT team. In this role, you will focus on building, scaling, and delivering impactful backend features for our core product, with a heavy emphasis on backend system optimization, automation, and expanding our integration capabilities with the wider Coupa ecosystem. Your work is directly connected to Coupa’s unified platform, where we redefine Business Spend Management. You will work closely with our Integrations team to design and evolve high-performing API layers . This is a highly autonomous role where you will tackle complex scalability challenges, write clean, robust code, and actively mentor other engineers to raise technical standards across the team.

jobs.description_text: The Impact of a Product Management Director, Supplier Network (AI-Powered) at Coupa: Coupa is scaling one of the world’s largest B2B supplier networks, connecting millions of buyers and suppliers globally through community-generated AI and trillions of dollars in direct and indirect spend data. L’AHOD veille à ce que tous les éléments d’éclairage, de projection vidéo et d’effets spéciaux respectent les normes les plus élevées en matière de sécurité, de qualité artistique et d’excellence technique. We're just getting started. We are now opening our first office in Asia-Pacific, in Hong Kong. jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.description_text: Position Status: Contingent Upon Program Award As a Lead (Chief) Satellite Systems Engineer, you will serve as a primary technical authority for satellite and space-system development programs, ensuring the integrity of system design, integration, verification, and mission readiness from concept through delivery. The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience delivering through at least one satellite-level program lifecycle. This position is intended for a technical leader who can operate with credibility across engineering, program management, product assurance, suppliers, customers, and senior leadership. T1/T2 expectations emphasize ownership of technical outcomes, disciplined integration, requirements alignment, decision closure, readiness evidence, and system-wide integration readiness across multiple subsystems.
